releases.notes:
Bug-fix release for SmartMoving on Minecraft 1.21.1.                                                                 
                                                                                                                       
  ## What's Changed                                                                                                    
  - **Fixed** the player sinking into the ground when rapidly switching slides in build mode.                          
                                                                                                                       
  ## Requirements                                                                                                      
  - Minecraft `1.21.1`                                                                                                 
  - Fabric Loader `0.19.2+`                                                                                            
  - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)                                                                  
  - Java `21`                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                       
  ## Installation                                                                                                      
  1. Install Fabric Loader                                                                                             
  2. Put Fabric API into the `mods/` folder                                                                            
  3. Put `smartmoving-1.0.1+1.21.1.jar` into the `mods/` folder                                                        
  4. Launch Minecraft                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                       
  For multiplayer, both server and client must have the mod installed.                                                 
                                                                                           
  **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/View-Studio/SmartMoving/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1

mods.description: A Minecraft mod that enriches character movement. Fabric 1.21.1 port of the classic SmartMoving — climbing, crawling, sliding, head jump and more.

releases.notes:
First Fabric release of SmartMoving for Minecraft 1.21.1 — a port of the classic SmartMoving (1.7.10 Forge).

  ## Features
  - **Climbing** — Block / ladder / vine / fence / iron bar self-climbing + ceiling climbing
  - **Crawling** — 1-block-tall space entry, head rotation, crawl-climbing, slide ↔ crawl transitions       
  - **Sliding** — Sneak-launched sliding, post-flight landing slide
  - **Head Jump** — Jump + sneak launched jump, fox movement
  - **Swimming** — Swim / dive states + swing animation
  - **Wall Jump** — Mid-air wall jump
  - **Vine Climbing** — Weeping / twisting vines ladder animation
  - **Multiplayer Sync** — Full self ↔ server ↔ remote state synchronization

  ## Requirements
  - Minecraft `1.21.1`
  - Fabric Loader `0.19.2+`
  - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
  - Java `21`

  ## Installation
  1. Install Fabric Loader
  2. Put Fabric API into the `mods/` folder
  3. Put `smartmoving-1.0.0+1.21.1.jar` into the `mods/` folder
  4. Launch Minecraft

  For multiplayer, both server and client must have the mod installed.
